extracted.name: Marinated Grilled Shrimp
extracted.description: Learn how to marinate shrimp for grilling with this easy marinade of garlicky tomato sauce with vinegar and basil, great with frozen or fresh shrimp.
ingredient_lines: 2 pounds fresh shrimp, peeled and deveined
instruction_lines: Stir olive oil, tomato sauce, garlic, and red wine vinegar together in a large bowl. Season with basil, salt, and cayenne pepper.
Add shrimp to the bowl; stir until evenly coated. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes to 1 hour, stirring once or twice.
Preheat the grill to medium heat. Lightly oil the grate.
Thread shrimp onto skewers, piercing once near the tail and once near the head. Discard marinade.
Cook shrimp on the preheated grill until opaque, 2 to 3 minutes per side.
